booyah.heading: Booyah layout
booyah.body1: This design fills with the winner of a map, not a standings table. Row slot 1 is the winning TEAM, and its numbers come straight from the leaderboard. Slots 2 and up are that team's PLAYERS, with the stats they got in the map they just won.
booyah.body2: So build it with two column groups: one group of 1 row starting at rank 1 for the team (team name, team logo, map, total points), then a second group starting at rank 2 for the squad (player name, player image, kills, damage). Add the big "BOOYAH!" word as a text element.

playerBoard.heading: Player board layout
playerBoard.body1: This design fills with RANKED PLAYERS, not teams. Row 1 is the player at the top of the board, row 2 the next, and so on. Each row carries that player's name, photo, team, kills, damage, assists and map MVPs won.
playerBoard.body2: How many players appear is decided here, not on the overlay: a column group of 1 row starting at rank 1 shows the leader alone, which is the MVP moment; a group of 10 rows shows the top ten; two groups of 5 show two columns side by side.

h2h.heading: Head to head layout
h2h.body1: This design fills with ONE ROW PER SIDE. Row 1 is the first competitor you pick, row 2 the second, row 3 the optional third. A team comparison fills team name, team logo, team flag, kills, total points, booyahs and maps played; a player comparison fills player name, player image, kills, damage and assists.
h2h.body2: So build the two sides as two column groups of 1 row each: give both the same row start, set one to start at rank 1 and the other at rank 2, then drag the first group's columns to the left of the canvas and the second group's to the right. A third side is a third group. Bracket mode ignores these columns and always draws the stage bracket.

versus.heading: Versus layout
versus.hint: Drag the numbered boxes on the canvas - the head-to-head places each competitor card exactly there. Tick the stat rows every card shows (in this order).
